description: Deploy a Discord bot or a web app from a public or private GitHub/GitLab repository. The language is detected from the repo (Node.js, Python, Bun, Deno, Go, Java, PHP, Ruby, or a static site); the app is cloned, built and started, and every push to the branch redeploys it. A Discord bot needs DISCORD_TOKEN in env. With web_address (a name), the app also gets https://<name>.fadehost.app pointing at the port it listens on (the PORT variable, 8080 by default); every app has one with its plan at no extra cost. Free tier: one app per account, 256 MB, and its web address sleeps when nobody is visiting it; paid tiers starter (1 GB, $2/mo), standard (2 GB, $3/mo), pro (4 GB, $6/mo) need Bot Hosting units on the subscription.

branch.description: Branch to deploy; default is the repository default branch.

build_command.description: A build step to run after install (e.g. "npm run build").

build_mode.description: "runtime" (default) installs and starts the repository in a shared runtime. "dockerfile" builds the repository's own Dockerfile into an image first. "railpack" works out how to build a repository that has no Dockerfile. Both build modes are paid tiers only.

env.description: Environment variables as a map of NAME to value (DISCORD_TOKEN for bots, API keys, ...).

git_token.description: A token for a private repository (a GitHub fine-grained token or the GitHub App connection is preferred).

kind.description: "discord" for a Discord bot (needs DISCORD_TOKEN), "telegram" or "whatsapp" for those bots, "web" for a web app or API, "static" for a static site, "worker" for anything else that keeps running. Default discord.

name.description: A name for the app (3 to 60 characters).

port.description: The port the app listens on for its web address; default 8080 (the PORT variable).

region.description: Part of a region name, e.g. "Europe" or "USA". Default Europe.

runtime.description: The language to run the repository as; leave empty to detect it from the files in the repo.

tier.description: free (default when the account still has its free app), starter, standard or pro.

web_address.description: A name for a public web address, e.g. "my-dashboard" for https://my-dashboard.fadehost.app. Included with every app.

name: create_app

message.description: What was created and what happens next.

url.description: The web address when one was set up, else null.

title: Create App
